hints.title: Placeholder Parsing
hints.text: Locate bracketed placeholders demarcated by percent symbols and extract their variable keys.

hints.title: Recursive Expansion
hints.text: A replacement value can contain other placeholders. Expand variables recursively since the dependency graph is guaranteed acyclic.

hints.title: Memoized Evaluation
hints.text: Cache the fully expanded string for each variable key to avoid repeated evaluations of identical placeholders.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: L: length of the final expanded text
complexity.notes: Memoization ensures each replacement key is fully expanded once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string search-and-replace without memoization leads to exponential string copying.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching resolved variable strings avoids re-expanding shared nested variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use recursion with memoization to evaluate acyclic grammar substitutions.
